title: Implement synchronous antivirus scan mode

context.summary: Make sync_scan a real upload-time ClamAV verdict path.
context.background: When configured, upload must not return success until the raw object has a clean antivirus verdict.

in: Wire upload-time synchronous scanning through the ClamAV scanner.
Apply infected and scan-failure policies before document processing is enqueued.
Persist document/job statuses for clean, infected and failed sync scan results.
Add live ClamAV integration tests for clean and infected fixtures.
Remove TASK-94-owned public-readiness debt from the gate.

acceptance_criteria: sync_scan upload waits for a ClamAV verdict.
Clean uploads create processing jobs after scan success.
Infected uploads are quarantined or deleted according to policy before processing.
Scan failures obey configured block or allow-with-warning behavior.

manual_checks: Confirm no sync_scan not-implemented marker remains.

risks: Synchronous scanning can increase upload latency and must use explicit timeout handling.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
